component: WebExtension schema naming and list style

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 651 inserts rss while changing the NativeMailAccountType enums into lexical order. Current enums retain that order after adding ews. Proposed scoped manual JSON style: keep these native type lists alphabetized and update both version choices together, while preserving the version-specific none/local spelling. This is supported by this schema family, not a rule that all enum order is arbitrary or that a formatter enforces it.
title: Keep schema enum lists ordered within the native account type family
